documented_failure_cases.target: Mung bean isolate under pH-shifting treatment
documented_failure_cases.observation: Native mung bean isolate exhibits an LGC of 22% (WHC: 1.56 g/g). Following pH 12 alkaline unfolding and neutralization, LGC drops to 15% and WHC surges to 4.81 g/g.
documented_failure_cases.why_model_cannot_predict: Proti IQ evaluates primary amino acid sequences, ESM-2 fold embeddings, and native AlphaFold structures. It cannot capture extreme quaternary restructuring, thermal denaturing, or alkaline unfolding induced by industrial processing.
documented_failure_cases.user_implication: Computational scores guide native crop selection; processing optimization remains strictly empirical.
